statement: Because the kernel unregisters input devices at disconnect and allocates new input devices at later attachment, a complete disconnect-reconnect observed by this consumer implies a new evdev device lifetime rather than a neutral-frame-only transition. The exact event-node numbering, stable symlinks and persistence of receiver association require host validation; this supports an explicit slot epoch in the ADR-0022 model.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
